name: Lark M2 Battery
author: soradev
description: Battery level of the Hollyland Lark M2 transmitters, read from the USB receiver. Hidden while the receiver is unplugged.

barWidget.description: Mic icon; click opens a panel with Mic 1 / Mic 2 battery, read live.

schema.label: Refresh (s)
schema.description: Background check for the low-battery alert while the receiver is plugged in (the panel always reads live).

schema.label: Low battery (%)
schema.description: Turn red and notify below this level.
